_README: nosub_con_lag_screen adjudication, 2026-08-10 (runbook §73a). The 17-cell screen was a SCREEN, not a verdict.
RESULT: 9 cells healed (11 slot-values), 8 confirmed correct and left alone. Plus 10 COMPANION cells (20 slot-values)
proven wrong by the very same documents, healed with them (§73 precedent: 6 companions healed en route).
The screen's own two 'strong scale signature' guesses scored 1.5 of 2: SIMPLEXCAS was indeed x100 but on the STD side
with the CON side ALSO wrong (it held a copy of std, not the filing's -2.78); VISHAL was x100 on std while its con 7.35
was correct all along. So even the confident half of the screen would have written a wrong con value if trusted.
METHOD, per the §73a recipe: (1) establish whether the company files consolidated AT ALL - NSE corporates-financial-results
+ integrated-filing-results row bases, the nature tags of the cached XBRLs, and (for the 9 BSE-only names, which have no
NSE rows because they are NOT NSE-LISTED - absent from EQUITY_L's 2,410 rows) the filing document itself plus screener;
(2) if it never files consolidated, the con slot is the con=std identity - but VERIFY THE STD against a filing first,
since the disagreeing side may be std (it was, in 4 of the 9 heals); (3) if it does file consolidated, read that filing.
Every value written traces to a document read this session. Nothing was inferred from our own series.
